description_en: This API only provides the signing functionality for acquiring an authorization token during UAID retrieval from the three-network operators
description_zh: 该API仅提供三网运营商获取UAID能力中，获取授权Token环节的签名功能
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi get-uaid-apply-token-sign --auth-code HwD97InG --out-id b8b5b3a00000000b9893484fdf412c99 --client-type 30300 --time 20121227180001165 --carrier CM --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetUAIDApplyTokenSign

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

To obtain this authorization code, navigate to Tag Plaza in the Phone Number Verification Service (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square) console, select a tag, and submit an application. You receive the code after your application is approved
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

在号码分析服务->标签广场 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square)选择标签，提交使用申请，申请通过后，会获得该授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The external ID.

For China Mobile (CM), this parameter corresponds to `traceId` and `msgId`. The values of `OutId`, `traceId`, and `msgId` must be the same
parameters.help_zh:
外部流水号。
对应移动（CM）运营商中的traceId、msgId，三者保持一致即可
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
The client type. Valid values:

`30100`: Android

`30300`: iOS

`20200`: H5

`10010`: Web
parameters.help_zh:
客户端类型。
Android：30100
IOS：30300
H5：20200
WEB：10010
parameters.name: client_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required if the carrier is China Telecom (CT). For details, see the China Telecom documentation
parameters.help_zh: 运营商为电信（CT）时必传，具体参考电信运营商文档
parameters.name: param_key

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required if the carrier is China Telecom (CT). For details, see the China Telecom documentation
parameters.help_zh: 运营商为电信（CT）时必传，具体参考电信运营商文档
parameters.name: param_str

parameters.help_en:
The event timestamp, accurate to the millisecond.
Format: `yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS`.
parameters.help_zh:
事件发生的时间戳，精确到毫秒。  
格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS
parameters.name: time

parameters.help_en:
The mobile carrier. Valid values:

CM: China Mobile

CU: China Unicom

CT: China Telecom
parameters.help_zh:
用户所处的运营商。取值：
CM：中国移动。
CU：中国联通。
CT：中国电信
parameters.name: carrier
